answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation on both standard Indonesian and colloquial Indonesian of COPAL-ID. This evaluation is performed by a completely different group of annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are instructed to choose the most plausible option by checking the checkbox provided next to each option. Factors that can be used as a basis for choosing include: 1. Choose the most likely option in the context of Indonesia and Jakarta. 2. Facts and statistics. 3. Sensible stereotypes. 4. Cause and effect relationships. 5. Personal knowledge/common sense.
